name: Notifications
why: What raises an alert and how fast you clear it
ideal: Only a post, an error or a request for input raises an alert, and the oldest wait clears within a day.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects

steps.name: Event
steps.rule: An alert is a post in the conversation, a thread error or a thread that needs your input.

steps.name: Sort
steps.rule: Keep the default alerts; add one per finished turn only if you need it.

steps.name: You act
steps.rule: Answer a thread listed under Waiting on you within a day.
